civilFromEmailString
metadata.description:
Converts a given RFC 5322 formatted string (e.g., `Wed, 10 Mar 2021 19:51:55 -0800 (PST)`) to a civil record.
```ballerina
time:Civil|time:Error emailDateTime = time:civilFromEmailString("Wed, 10 Mar 2021 19:51:55 -0820");
```

metadata.label: loadSystemZone
metadata.description:
Loads the default time zone of the system.
```ballerina
time:Zone|time:Error zone = time:loadSystemZone();
```

metadata.label: monotonicNow
metadata.description:
Returns the number of seconds from an unspecified epoch.
This API guarantees consistent value increase in subsequent calls with nanoseconds precision.
```ballerina
decimal seconds = time:monotonicNow();
```

metadata.label: utcAddSeconds
metadata.description:
Returns UTC time that occurs seconds after the given UTC time.
This assumes that all days have 86400 seconds except when UTC represents a time during a positive leap second,
in which case the corresponding day will be assumed to have 86401 seconds.
```ballerina
time:Utc utc = time:utcAddSeconds(time:utcNow(), 20.900);
```

metadata.label: utcDiffSeconds
utcFromCivil
utcFromString
metadata.description:
Converts an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g., `2007-12-03T10:15:30.00Z`) to UTC.
```ballerina
time:Utc|time:Error utc = time:utcFromString("2007-12-03T10:15:30.00Z");
```

metadata.label: utcNow
metadata.description:
Returns the `time:Utc` representing the current time (current instant of the system clock in seconds from the epoch of `1970-01-01T00:00:00`).
```ballerina
time:Utc utc = time:utcNow();
```

utcToString

metadata.label: Standard Library
metadata.description: Components supported officially by Ballerina

metadata.label: 'join
metadata.description:
Joins zero or more strings together with a separator.

```ballerina
string:'join(" ", "Ballerina", "is", "a", "programming", "language") ⇒ Ballerina is a programming language
string[] array = ["John", "23", "USA", "Computer Science", "Swimmer"];
string:'join(",", ...array) ⇒ John,23,USA,Computer Science,Swimmer
```

metadata.label: 'map
metadata.description:
Applies a function to each member of an array and returns an array of the results.

```ballerina
int[] numbers = [0, 1, 2];
numbers.map(n => n * 2) ⇒ [0,2,4]
```

metadata.label: 'map
'map
'map
add
'map
metadata.description:
Applies a function to each item in an xml sequence, and returns an xml sequence of the results.

Each item is represented as a singleton value.

```ballerina
xml x = xml `<book>Hamlet</book><book>Macbeth</book>`;
x.map(function (xml xmlContent) returns xml => 
  xml `<book kind="play">${xmlContent.children()}</book>`
) ⇒ <book kind="play">Hamlet</book><book kind="play">Macbeth</book>
```

metadata.label: __addError
metadata.description: Adds an error to the GraphQL response. Using this to add an error is not recommended.

metadata.label: abs
metadata.description:
Returns the IEEE absolute value of a decimal value.

```ballerina
decimal d = -3.21;
d.abs() ⇒ 3.21
```

metadata.label: abs
metadata.description:
Returns the IEEE absolute value of a float value.

```ballerina
float f = -3.21;
f.abs() ⇒ 3.21
```

metadata.label: acos
metadata.description:
Returns the arccosine of a float value.

Corresponds to IEEE acos operation.

```ballerina
float f = 0.5;
f.acos() ⇒ 1.0471975511965979
```

metadata.label: asin
metadata.description:
Returns the arcsine of a float value.

Corresponds to IEEE asin operation.

```ballerina
float f = 0.5;
f.asin() ⇒ 0.5235987755982989
```

metadata.label: abs
metadata.description:
Returns the absolute value of an int value.

```ballerina
int n = -25;
n.abs() ⇒ 25
int:abs(-30) ⇒ 30
```
